control_R151C.note: measured from the .sto already present in each R151C result directory, the corpus control measurement; reproduces the -7.8500 deg control mean quoted in PREREG_biarticular_r402.md section 1.

uninformative_rule: a rung with fewer than 4 Gate-G seeds is UNINFORMATIVE and is reported, not dropped; fewer than 4 in BOTH at KV 0.110 makes the whole registration UNINFORMATIVE.
